AUTO-PILOT has detected the end of narrative hibernation and would like to thank you for your time using the product.
lines.zh: AUTO-PILOT 检测到叙事休眠已结束，并感谢您使用本产品所花费的时间。

lines.en: Please note that exiting hibernation early can result in loss of memory. As such, Akira Arakawa may no longer be a reliable narrator.
lines.zh: 请注意，提前退出休眠可能导致记忆缺失。因此，Akira Arakawa 可能不再是可靠的叙述者。

lines.en: Additionally, it is possible that he was never a reliable narrator to begin with.
lines.zh: 此外，也有可能他从一开始就不是个可靠的叙述者。

lines.en: This is not to say that AUTO-PILOT claims to be “reliable.” But it urges you to be careful of who you speak to and what you wish for as a wish for the wrong thing could result in permanent system failure.
lines.zh: 这并不是说 AUTO-PILOT 自称「可靠」。但它提醒您谨慎选择与谁交谈、以及许下什么愿望，因为许错愿望可能导致系统永久故障。

lines.en: AUTO-PILOT is now {b}OFF.{/b}
lines.zh: AUTO-PILOT 现已{b}关闭{/b}。

lines.en: //\\/\\/\/\\/\\//\\\AKIRA ASSUMES CONTROL
lines.zh: //\/\/\/\/\//\\\AKIRA ASSUMES CONTROL

lines.en: I keep hearing voices in my head...
lines.zh: 我脑子里一直有声音……

lines.en: Seeing figures in my sleep.
lines.zh: 睡着时看见人影。

lines.en: And while it doesn’t feel like any of them are out to get me, I’m not sure I can trust them either.
lines.zh: 虽然感觉它们没一个是要来对付我的，但我也说不准能不能信任它们。

lines.en: I’ve been having this recurring dream lately, but I’m not sure what it means.
lines.zh: 最近我一直在做同一个反复出现的梦，但我不确定它意味着什么。

lines.en: When I open my eyes (Though, I’m not actually opening my eyes) there are clocks, some water, and a bed.
lines.zh: 当我睁开眼睛时（虽说，我其实并没有真的睁开眼睛），眼前有一些钟、一些水，还有一张床。

lines.en: It’s the same bed I fell asleep in. The same bed I’m waking up in now. But beside me in the dream is someone who can’t join me in here.
lines.zh: 那是我睡着时的那张床。也是我现在醒来时躺的那张床。可在梦里躺在我身边的，是一个无法跟我一起来到这里的人。

lines.en: She’s a normal teenage girl who goes by the name Maya Makinami.
lines.zh: 她是个普通的少女，名叫 Maya Makinami。

lines.en: She loves food and weird manga, but hates the way I look at her.
lines.zh: 她喜欢美食和奇怪的漫画，却讨厌我看她的眼神。

lines.en: She claims to play the violin and I’ve heard that she’s a wonderful singer, yet these ears have not once experienced either.
lines.zh: 她声称自己会拉小提琴，我也听说她唱歌很好听，可我这双耳朵一次也没有体验过其中任何一样。

lines.en: Come to think of it, the list of things I {i}haven’t{/i} experienced with her is far greater than the list of things which I have.
lines.zh: 这么一想，我{i}没有{/i}和她一起经历过的事，远比经历过的事要多得多。

lines.en: It’s kind of ridiculous, isn’t it?
lines.zh: 挺荒唐的，不是吗？

lines.en: That the two of us, a match made in hell, wound up together in an infinite world, yet experienced little more than a pair of coworkers would.
lines.zh: 我们两个，一对地狱里撮合的姻缘，最终在这无限的世界里走到了一起，经历过的却比一对同事多不了多少。

lines.en: But now, it’s over.
lines.zh: 但现在，一切都结束了。

lines.en: Now, I have to wait until my eyes are closed to see her. And even then, it’s not the same.
lines.zh: 现在，我得等到闭上眼睛才能见到她。即便如此，也不一样了。

lines.en: Our meetings in my head are somehow cut even shorter than our meeting on the outside, and I’m beginning to worry that there’s nothing I can do to change that.
lines.zh: 我脑海里的相会，不知怎的比我们在外面的相会还要短暂，我开始担心自己恐怕无力改变这一点。

lines.en: I don’t know how long I’ve been inside this room.
lines.zh: 我不知道自己在这个房间里待了多久。

lines.en: I know that Ami’s been taking care of me. I can hear her voice like it’s bleeding through a speaker while I wade through water past puppeteered angels and white oak doors.
lines.zh: 我知道一直是 Ami 在照顾我。我蹚过水，路过被操纵的天使和白色橡木门时，能听见她的声音像是从扬声器里漏出来一样。

lines.en: It comes and goes. Just like the dreams. And in my brief moments of consciousness, I can often smell the scent of her perfume lingering on the sheets beside me.
lines.zh: 它时有时无。就像那些梦一样。而在我短暂的清醒时刻，我常常能闻到身旁的床单上残留着她的香水味。

lines.en: I know exactly where she got it...and why she chose the scent. But what she doesn’t seem to know is that I don’t like it anymore.
lines.zh: 我清楚她是从哪儿买的……也清楚她为什么选这个味道。可她似乎不知道的是，我已经不喜欢它了。

lines.en: scene senseiupagain4
So, what {i}do{/i} I like?
lines.zh: 那么，我{i}到底{/i}喜欢什么？

lines.en: This?
lines.zh: 这个？

lines.en: Is {i}this{/i} where I belong? Surrounded by walls that keep me from spreading my toxic seed across the city? Or are they keeping me safe instead?
lines.zh: {i}这里{/i}就是我的归宿吗？被四面墙围着，好让我没法把自己的毒种撒遍整座城市？还是说，它们是在保护我？

lines.en: Leaving here would just lead to me getting attached to something else.
lines.zh: 离开这里，只会让我又对别的东西产生依恋。

lines.en: And if I never get attached to anything, I won’t ever have to experience this again. Right?
lines.zh: 而如果我永远不对任何东西产生依恋，就再也不必经历这种事了。对吧？

lines.en: I wonder if that’s what happened last time.
lines.zh: 我在想，上一次是不是就是这样。

lines.en: It has to be, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: 一定是这样，不是吗？

lines.en: I was probably just as hopeless and helpless as I am now — confined to bed and sponge-bathed by a girl who only exists to please and pamper me.
lines.zh: 那时的我大概和现在一样绝望无助——困在床上，由一个只为取悦我、娇惯我而存在的女孩给我擦身。

lines.en: I don’t deserve any of it. And Ami surely doesn’t deserve a life in which {i}she{/i} needs to be the grown-up while I sit here dreaming of fucking her now-deceased friend.
lines.zh: 这一切我都不配。而 Ami 更不该过这样的日子——{i}她{/i}得当那个大人，而我坐在这里，做着和她那位已故朋友做爱的梦。

lines.en: Sometimes, I wish I could chop my hands off so I wouldn’t be able to strangle the joy out of life itself. But I always keep them because I like how they feel around my throat.
lines.zh: 有时候，我真希望能把自己的手砍下来，这样我就没法掐死生活本身的喜悦了。可我总是留着它们，因为我喜欢它们扼住我喉咙时的感觉。

lines.en: If I have to stay here forever, I will.
lines.zh: 如果非要我永远待在这里，那我就待着。

lines.en: Leaving everything else behind will be easy when I’ve already lost the one thing I wanted to keep.
lines.zh: 既然我已经失去了唯一想留住的东西，把其他一切抛在身后也就很容易了。

scene senseiupagain4
She’ll be fine, won’t she?
lines.zh: 她会没事的，对吧？

lines.en: It’s true that she’s still young, but she’s much stronger than I’ve ever been. And if I know her at all, I imagine she’s probably been trying to get to me this whole time.
lines.zh: 她确实还小，但她比我任何时候都要坚强。而如果我算了解她的话，我想她大概这一整段时间都在设法接近我。

lines.en: I wonder if the others have done the same? And, if so, how many have managed to get past my unbreakable wall of a niece.
lines.zh: 不知道其他人是不是也一样？如果是的话，又有多少人能突破我那道坚不可摧的侄女之墙。

lines.en: Probably none of them. Ami doesn’t crumble under pressure like I do — at least not under the pressure of anyone but me.
lines.zh: 大概一个都没有。Ami 不会像我一样在压力下崩溃——至少除了我以外，谁的压力都压不垮她。

lines.en: I’m sure I could get through to her if I wanted, but...I’m not sure I do.
lines.zh: 我确信只要我想，就能说动她，可是……我不确定自己想不想。

lines.en: In fact, being sure of {i}anything{/i} seems highly improbable right now as I just dreamt up a flower-headed Virgin Mary...scissor angel...spider thing.
lines.zh: 事实上，此刻要对{i}任何事{/i}有把握都极不可能，因为我刚刚凭空梦见了一个花脑袋的圣母玛利亚……剪刀天使……蜘蛛一样的东西。

lines.en: Its words still ring in my ears, sounding like a cross between thunder and a church organ, but it’s merely one line that plays on repeat.
lines.zh: 它的话仍在我耳边回响，听上去像是雷声与教堂管风琴的混合体，可翻来覆去只有一句。

lines.en: “Drag yourself out of bed or you will {i}never{/i} have the chance to live again.”
lines.zh: 「把自己从床上拖起来，否则你{i}永远{/i}都不会再有活下去的机会。」

lines.en: It’s a line I’d disregard from anyone. And even if {i}this{/i} entity could cut me into pieces with its wings, I’m not inclined to start listening {i}now.{/i}
lines.zh: 这话换成任何人说，我都会当耳旁风。而且就算{i}这个{/i}存在能用翅膀把我切成碎片，我也不打算{i}现在{/i}就开始听话。

lines.en: And yet...
lines.zh: 可是……

lines.en: I feel as if I {i}should.{/i}
lines.zh: 我又觉得自己{i}应该{/i}听话。

lines.en: I have never trusted {s}god{/s} God. And I likely never will.
lines.zh: 我从来没有相信过{s}神{/s}上帝。而且大概永远也不会。

lines.en: But there is nothing I can do to bring her back {i}alone...{/i}
lines.zh: 可是{i}光靠我自己{/i}，我什么也做不了，没法把她带回来……

lines.en: And for the first time in forever, I am feeling desperate.
lines.zh: 这么久以来，我第一次感到了绝望。

lines.en: : Senseiiiii!
lines.zh: : Sensei—————！

: I brought a special treat for you this morning!
lines.zh: : 今天早上我给你带了一份特别的点心！

lines.en: : I haven’t tried making okonomiyaki in forever, but I figured I should do something special since you had a really stressful day yesterday!
lines.zh: : 我已经很久很久没做过御好烧了，不过我想，既然你昨天过得特别累，我总该做点特别的东西！

: But, since I know you’re probably still asleep-
lines.zh: : 不过呢，我知道你大概还睡着——

: Good morning, Ami...
lines.zh: : 早上好，Ami……

lines.en: scene senseiupagain11

lines.zh: : Ami？……

lines.en: scene senseiupagain12
: I...take it you’re surprised to see me awake?
lines.zh: : 我……看来你看到我醒着很吃惊？

lines.en: : Ami?
lines.zh: : Ami？

lines.en: scene senseiupagain13
: Oh. I dropped the okonomiyaki.
lines.zh: : 哦。我把御好烧掉地上了。

lines.en: : Why did you make okonomiyaki for breakfast in the first place? That’s not really...a thing most people eat in the morning.
lines.zh: : 你到底为什么一大早做御好烧啊？那本来就不是……大多数人早上会吃的东西吧。

lines.en: : I’ll have to make another one now. Oh well.
lines.zh: : 那我现在得再做一个了。算了。

lines.en: : Uh...can we talk for a minute?
lines.zh: : 呃……我们能聊一会儿吗？

lines.en: scene senseiupagain14
: Nuh-uh, [amimaster]! {i}You’re{/i} the clumsy one here! Just because I dropped {i}one{/i} thing doesn’t mean I’m no longer the ultimate niece!
lines.zh: : 才不是，[amimaster]！{i}你{/i}才是那个笨手笨脚的！我只不过掉了{i}一{/i}样东西，不代表我就不再是终极侄女了！

lines.en: : Oh, stop! You don’t mean that at all!
lines.zh: : 哦，别这么说！你根本不是那个意思！

lines.en: : Ami...what’s going on with you?
lines.zh: : Ami……你怎么了？

lines.en: scene senseiupagain15
: What’s going on with {i}me?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}怎么了？

lines.en: : Nothing, [amimaster]. I’m not the one who’s broken right now. I’m the one taking {i}care{/i} of the broken person. {i}You.{/i}
lines.zh: : 没什么，[amimaster]。现在坏掉的人不是我。坏掉的那个人是{i}你{/i}，而我是在{i}照顾{/i}你的那个人。

lines.en: : So what’s going on with {i}you,{/i} [amimaster]? Why are you being so weird all of a sudden? You need to get your rest. Go back to sleep and I’ll make you a new breakfast. Okay? Okay. Good.
lines.zh: : 那么{i}你{/i}又怎么了，[amimaster]？怎么突然变得这么奇怪？你需要休息。回去睡觉，我给你做份新的早餐。好吗？好吗。很好。

lines.en: : And remember, there’s no one in the world who will ever love you as much as I do. And also, if you happened to find a message that Uta and Io sneakily left here, please give it to me. It could have anthrax.
lines.zh: : 还有，别忘了，这世上没有人会比我更爱你。另外，如果你碰巧发现了 Uta 和 Io 偷偷留在这儿的东西，请交给我。那上面可能有炭疽。

lines.en: : Uta and Io? They were here? When?
lines.zh: : Uta 和 Io？她们来过这儿？什么时候？

lines.en: scene senseiupagain14
: Never! That was a joke I just made up! Hahah! I’m so funny! Right, [amimaster]! I’m such a silly girl!
lines.zh: : 没有！那是我刚编出来的玩笑！哈哈哈！我太好笑了！对吧，[amimaster]！我真是个傻姑娘！

lines.en: : Ami-
lines.zh: : Ami——

lines.en: scene senseiupagain16
scene senseiupagain17
scene senseiupagain18
scene senseiupagain19
scene senseiupagain16
scene senseiupagain17
scene senseiupagain18

: Why why why why why why why why why why why why?!?! Why are you awake!??!?! What happened?!?!?! Are you okay?!?!? What’s wrong?!?! Tell me what’s wrong!!!
lines.zh: : 为什么为什么为什么为什么为什么为什么为什么为什么为什么为什么为什么为什么？！？！你为什么醒了！？？！？！发生了什么？！？！？！你还好吗？！？！？哪里不对劲？！？！告诉我哪里不对劲！！！

lines.en: : It was a dream, wasn’t it?!?! You had a dream again!!!! What happened in the dream, [amimaster]?!?!? What did you hear?!! Tell me right now!!! Tell me tell me tell me tell me tell me!
lines.zh: : 是梦，对不对？！？！你又做梦了！！！！梦里发生了什么，[amimaster]？！？！？你听到了什么？！！现在就告诉我！！！告诉我告诉我告诉我告诉我告诉我！

lines.en: : Hey, calm down. There’s no need to-
lines.zh: : 嘿，冷静点。没必要——

lines.en: : YES THERE FUCKING IS AND NO I WON’T CALM DOWN YOU’RE HAVING A PANIC ATTACK YOU NEED TO LIE DOWN LIE DOWN RIGHT NOW SENSEI LIE DOWN LIE DOWN LIE DOWN LIE DOWN LIE DOWN!
lines.zh: : 他妈的当然有必要，而且我就是不冷静你这是惊恐发作你需要躺下现在就躺下Sensei躺下躺下躺下躺下躺下！

lines.en: : Ami-
lines.zh: : Ami——

lines.en: scene senseiupagain21
: LIE DOWN LIE DOWN LIE DOWN LIE DOWN LIE DOWN YOU NEED TO LIE DOWN LIE DOWN AND GO TO SLEEP LIE DOWN SENSEI LIE DOWN LIE DOWN LIE DOWN LIE DOWN LIE-
lines.zh: : 躺下躺下躺下躺下躺下你需要躺下躺下然后睡觉躺下Sensei躺下躺下躺下躺下躺——

lines.en: : Ami, shut up. Please.
lines.zh: : Ami，闭嘴。拜托。

lines.en: scene senseiupagain22
: No! You’re not ready to go back to normal yet! You haven’t waited long enough! You’re only like this because Uta and Io interrupted the healing process! We have to start over! Now! Now now now!
lines.zh: : 不！你还没准备好恢复正常！你等得还不够久！你变成这样全是因为 Uta 和 Io 打断了治愈的过程！我们得重新开始！现在！就现在现在现在！

lines.en: : So they {i}were{/i} here after all, huh?
lines.zh: : 这么说来她们{i}确实{/i}来过了啊？

lines.en: scene senseiupagain23
: Soon, they won’t be anywhere ever again.
lines.zh: : 很快，她们就哪儿也去不了了。

lines.en: : Ami, look at me.
lines.zh: : Ami，看着我。

lines.en: scene senseiupagain24
: Why? So you can call me insane? So you can ridicule me for clinging to you like this and knowing what you need better than you do and trying to get you to rest for a little while longer?
lines.zh: : 为什么？好让你说我是疯子？好让你嘲笑我这样缠着你、嘲笑我比你更清楚你需要什么、嘲笑我只是想让你再多休息一阵？

lines.en: scene senseiupagain25
: So you can tell me I’m suffocating you and that you need more space so you can go out into the world and get hurt again because you’re a masochist and you {i}love{/i} being hurt?!
lines.zh: : 好让你告诉我我让你窒息了，你需要更多空间，好再跑到外面的世界去受伤，因为你就是个受虐狂，你{i}就爱{/i}受伤？！

lines.en: : Is that what you want to tell me, [amimaster]?! Then go ahead! Nothing you say will ever hurt me because I know you love me deep deep deep deep down even if you keep choosing everyone else!
lines.zh: : 你想告诉我的就是这个吗，[amimaster]？！那就说啊！你说什么都不会伤到我，因为我知道，就算你一直选择别人，在你内心最深最深最深的地方，你是爱我的！

lines.en: : You are {i}my{/i} uncle! Nobody else can have you! And if I’m suffocating you, I’ll just open your mouth and give you CPR for the rest of our lives until our mouths fuse together!
lines.zh: : 你是我{i}的{/i}舅舅！谁也别想抢走你！要是我让你窒息了，我就掰开你的嘴，给你做一辈子的心肺复苏，一直做到我们的嘴长在一起！

lines.en: : Are you done yet?
lines.zh: : 你说完了吗？

lines.en: : No! Because I {i}also{/i} want to say that I have worked so so so so so so hard to keep you safe here and if you’re going to tell me I went too far, you’re wrong! You don’t get it! You’ll never get it!
lines.zh: : 没有！因为我{i}还{/i}想说，为了把你安全地留在这里，我付出了那么多、那么多、那么多的努力，你要是打算说我做得太过了，那你错了！你不懂！你永远不会懂！

lines.en: : You’re not meant to be a part of this world, Sensei! You belong with me! We belong together! In here! Where no one can hurt us and no one can hear us! You’re mine! Mine, mine, mine, mine, mine!
lines.zh: : 你本来就不该属于这个世界，Sensei！你属于我！我们该在一起！就在这里！在这里没人能伤害我们，也没人听得见我们！你是我的！我的，我的，我的，我的，我的！

lines.en: scene senseiupagain26
: And I will kill myself right now if you tell me that isn’t true. I mean it. I will.
lines.zh: : 你要是告诉我这不是真的，我现在就去死。我是认真的。我真的会。

lines.en: : {i}Now{/i} are you done?
lines.zh: : {i}现在{/i}你说完了吗？

lines.en: : Why are you awake?
lines.zh: : 你为什么醒着？

lines.en: : A better question is how long have I been out?
lines.zh: : 更好的问题是，我昏了多久？

lines.en: : Ami. Talk to me.
lines.zh: : Ami。跟我说话。

lines.en: scene senseiupagain27
: It’s the day after Christmas. You’ve been in here for almost two months.
lines.zh: : 今天是圣诞节后的第二天。你在这里待了快两个月了。

lines.en: : That long, huh?
lines.zh: : 那么久啊？

lines.en: : Did I give you any trouble?
lines.zh: : 我给你添麻烦了吗？

lines.en: scene senseiupagain28
: What? Of course not! I love taking care of you! I don’t even mind cleaning the bucket or helping you use the bathroom or-
lines.zh: : 什么？当然没有！我可爱死照顾你了！就连刷那个桶、扶你去上厕所我也一点都不介意，还有——

lines.en: : Okay. That’s not a thing I need or want to talk about right now.
lines.zh: : 好了。这件事我现在既不需要也不想谈。

lines.en: : What I’m saying is I love you, Sensei! {i}Nothing{/i} you do will ever be a burden to me!
lines.zh: : 我要说的是我爱你，Sensei！你做的{i}任何事{/i}都不可能是我的负担！

lines.en: : And...maybe that {i}is{/i} a little suffocating! But you just don’t get it! You’ll never get it! No matter what I do to make you understand!
lines.zh: : 还有……也许那{i}确实{/i}有点让人窒息！可你就是不懂！你永远都不会懂！不管我做什么想让你明白都没用！

lines.en: : Ami, I’m not upset with you for keeping me in here. Frankly, I probably {i}needed{/i} it.
lines.zh: : Ami，我没有因为你把我关在这里而生你的气。说实话，我大概{i}确实需要{/i}这样。

lines.en: : You still {i}do!{/i} You’re not supposed to be awake yet! It’s only been two months!
lines.zh: : 你现在{i}还是需要{/i}！你本来就不该醒过来！才过了两个月啊！

lines.en: : Two months is a long time to be shitting in a bucket, Ami.
lines.zh: : 两个月一直往桶里拉屎，已经很久了，Ami。

lines.en: scene senseiupagain29
: Nuh-uh...
lines.zh: : 才不是……

lines.en: : In fact, one {i}day{/i} is too long to be doing something like that. Besides, it’s not like I’m “going back to normal.” I’m just...awake. For the first time in what is apparently two months.
lines.zh: : 事实上，就算只有{i}一{/i}天，干那种事也够久了。再说了，我又不是在「恢复正常」。我只是……醒了。在显然是两个月以来的头一次。

lines.en: : That’s exactly the problem.
lines.zh: : 问题就在这儿。

lines.en: : You never want to spend time with me when you’re awake.
lines.zh: : 你醒着的时候，从来都不想陪我。

lines.en: : There are a million girls trying to trick you into believing we’re not meant to be together, but I have talked to God and he says that we are.
lines.zh: : 有上百万个女孩想骗你，让你相信我们不该在一起，可我跟上帝谈过了，他说我们该在一起。

lines.en: : Did that god also have spider legs and scissor wings?
lines.zh: : 那个上帝也有蜘蛛腿和剪刀翅膀吗？

lines.en: scene senseiupagain30
: Spider legs and...scissor wings?
lines.zh: : 蜘蛛腿和……剪刀翅膀？

lines.en: : Guess that was just mine then.
lines.zh: : 那看来那只是我自己的上帝了。

lines.en: : Is that why you’re awake? You got a message from God?
lines.zh: : 所以你才醒过来的？你收到了上帝的口信？

lines.en: : It’s more like I had a weird dream where some creature that may or may not have actually been a god told me to wake up. And that I’m so desperate for help now that I just...instinctively listened.
lines.zh: : 更像是我做了个怪梦，梦里有个可能是也可能不是神的东西叫我醒过来。而我现在的求助之心迫切到了极点，就……本能地听了话。

lines.en: : Have I not given you enough help? What else can I do to make you better? Tell me and I’ll do it. {i}Anything.{/i} And I mean {i}anything.{/i}
lines.zh: : 难道我给你的帮助还不够吗？我还能做什么让你好起来？告诉我，我就去做。{i}任何事{/i}。我是说{i}任何事{/i}。

lines.en: : Yeah, I’m sure you do...but I don’t think there’s anything you {i}can{/i} do, Ami.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我信你……但我觉得你{i}能{/i}做的也没有什么，Ami。

lines.en: : Try me.
lines.zh: : 你倒是说说看。

lines.en: : There’s no point. It would be a...conflict of interest.
lines.zh: : 没意义的。那会……有利益冲突。

lines.en: scene senseiupagain31
: It’s about {i}her{/i} again, isn’t it? {i}Maya.{/i}
lines.zh: : 又是为了{i}她{/i}，对不对？{i}Maya。{/i}

lines.en: : I don’t want to talk about her.
lines.zh: : 我不想谈她。

lines.en: : Really? Because you sure wanted to talk about her while I was wiping drool off of your chin and sweat off of your chest.
lines.zh: : 是吗？我给你擦下巴上的口水、擦胸口上的汗的时候，你可是很想谈她啊。

lines.en: : Yeah, well...you don’t need to worry about me trying to see her any time soon. I don’t want to.
lines.zh: : 嗯，好吧……你不用担心我短期内会去见她。我不想去。

lines.en: scene senseiupagain30
: You...don’t {i}want{/i} to? Why is that?
lines.zh: : 你……{i}不想{/i}？为什么？

lines.en: : It’s complicated.
lines.zh: : 说来话长。

lines.en: : I need to see Ayane, though. Now.
lines.zh: : 不过我需要见 Ayane。现在。

lines.en: scene senseiupagain32
: Huh?! Why?! There’s nothing she can do for you that I can’t!
lines.zh: : 啊？！为什么？！她能为你做的，我没有一样做不到！

lines.en: : I don’t need her to {i}do{/i} anything. And if you’re worried about me leaving the house, don’t be. I...want to stay here for now. With {i}you.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我不需要她{i}做{/i}什么。而且你要是担心我出门，大可不必。我……现在想待在这里。和{i}你{/i}一起。

lines.en: scene senseiupagain33
: But I need to see her.
lines.zh: : 但我需要见她。

lines.en: : She’s been worried, hasn’t she?
lines.zh: : 她一直很担心，对吧？

lines.en: scene senseiupagain34
: Or {i}pretending{/i} to be, just like everyone else. None of them are {i}actually{/i} worried about you. They just want their old routines back and don’t like having their toys taken away.
lines.zh: : 或者{i}装作{/i}很担心，就像其他人一样。她们{i}其实{/i}没有一个人真的担心你。她们只是想要回自己过去的日常，不喜欢自己的玩具被抢走。

lines.en: : And you think Ayane’s the same way?
lines.zh: : 你觉得 Ayane 也是那样？

lines.en: : See? You know her. So you know she’s {i}actually{/i} worried about me. And I can’t imagine she’s seen me at all since...whenever I went into stasis.
lines.zh: : 看吧？你了解她。所以你知道她是{i}真的{/i}在担心我。而且我想，自从我……不知什么时候进入停滞状态之后，她大概一眼都没见过我。

lines.en: : Do you have my phone? Because I don’t see it anywhere.
lines.zh: : 我的手机在你那儿吗？因为我哪儿都没看到它。

lines.en: : Maybe...
lines.zh: : 也许吧……

lines.en: : Then, can you call her and tell her to come over? Just to talk.
lines.zh: : 那么，你能打电话叫她过来吗？只是聊聊。

lines.en: : I don’t wanna. She’ll probably try to rape you and I don’t think I could kill her even if I wanted to.
lines.zh: : 我不想。她多半会试图强暴你，而且我觉得到时候就算我想杀她，也下不了手。

lines.en: : I think I’ll be able to hold my own, Ami.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我还招架得住，Ami。

lines.en: : I don’t know. She has guns.
lines.zh: : 我可说不好。她有枪。

lines.en: : Ami, please. For me.
lines.zh: : Ami，拜托了。为了我。

lines.en: scene senseiupagain35
: Sensei...I really don’t think you understand what you’re doing here.
lines.zh: : Sensei……我真的不觉得你明白自己在做什么。

lines.en: : You’ve got a real chance to live a happy life in this house. And not everybody gets one of those.
lines.zh: : 你有实实在在的机会，能在这栋房子里过上幸福的生活。而这种机会不是人人都有的。

lines.en: : What good are other girls when all of their best traits are wrapped up in me? What more could you want out of life?
lines.zh: : 其他女孩最好的地方全都集中在我身上了，她们还有什么用？你这一辈子还想要什么别的？

lines.en: : This is going to sound pretty depressing — and I imagine I’m going to be saying a lot of things like that from now on, so I might as well ease you into it here, but...
lines.zh: : 这话听起来会很丧——我想从今往后我还会说很多这样的话，不如就在这儿先让你慢慢适应，不过……

lines.en: : There’s nothing I want out of life anymore.
lines.zh: : 我已经不再想从生活里得到什么了。

lines.en: : I have no goals or desires...no dreams that aren’t hastily plastered together. But there are a handful of people that I want to protect. And you’re one of them, of course.
lines.zh: : 我没有目标，也没有欲望……没有一个不是草草拼凑起来的梦。但有那么几个人是我想保护的。而你当然是其中之一。

lines.en: : And Ayane is another?
lines.zh: : Ayane 也是其中一个？

lines.en: : That’s right.
lines.zh: : 没错。

lines.en: : How many more are there after her?
lines.zh: : 她之后还有多少个？

lines.en: : Well...there’s Niki. But she’s experienced this already, so she won’t mind waiting until after I talk to Ayane.
lines.zh: : 嗯……还有 Niki。不过她已经经历过这种事了，所以等我跟 Ayane 谈完再见她，她不会介意的。

lines.en: : And then?
lines.zh: : 然后呢？

lines.en: : Does it really matter? What will naming people do other than hurt you?
lines.zh: : 真有那么重要吗？把名字一个个说出来，除了伤害你还能怎样？

lines.en: : Water down just how much you care.
lines.zh: : 会把你在乎的程度给稀释掉。

lines.en: : What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 你是什么意思？

lines.en: : I mean you only have so much love to give. And if you spread it out among everyone, that leaves almost nothing for me.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，你能给出的爱就那么多。如果你把它分给所有人，那剩下给我的就几乎没有了。

lines.en: : I want you to realize that and stop yourself before you go too far. And right now, that’s exactly what you’re about to do.
lines.zh: : 我想让你意识到这一点，在走得太远之前及时止步。而现在，你正好就快要做到了。

lines.en: : You’re making a mistake, Sensei. You should stay here and stop thinking about other girls. We should be alone forever. I’ll drop out of school. We can move somewhere else. Start over.
lines.zh: : 你在犯错，Sensei。你应该留在这里，别再去想别的女孩。我们应该永远只有彼此。我可以退学。我们搬去别的地方。重新开始。

lines.en: : We already tried that once before, didn’t we?
lines.zh: : 我们以前已经试过一次了，不是吗？

lines.en: : Yeah.
lines.zh: : 是啊。

lines.en: : But you made a mistake.
lines.zh: : 可你犯了个错。

lines.en: : And now we’re right back where we started.
lines.zh: : 于是现在我们又回到了原点。

lines.en: : Just call her, Ami...please.
lines.zh: : 就打个电话给她吧，Ami……拜托。

lines.en: : I promise I won’t let her rape me.
lines.zh: : 我保证不会让她强暴我。

lines.en: : You really mean it?
lines.zh: : 你说话算数？

lines.en: : I really mean it.
lines.zh: : 我说话算数。

lines.en: scene senseiupagain36
: Hah...
scene black
: All this time and I still let you boss me around...it’s crazy how weak I am.
lines.zh: : 都过了这么久，我居然还是任你摆布……我到底有多软弱，真是疯了。
